name: Burns Philp Building, Normanton
scope: The standing timber and iron Burns Philp store in Normanton, including the three roof bays, decorative Landsborough Street facade, two street awnings and rear loading entrances.
era: Standing historic warehouse with the lettering and covered street edges documented by the state library photograph from around 1920.

originalReview.notes: The original ca. 1920 archive photograph shows the decorated Landsborough Street parapet, wraparound sheet-metal canopies, timber posts and the raised Caroline Street wall.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the published Qualla gallery. Both current photographs are CC BY 3.0, leaving no eligible exact reference. State Library of Queensland supplies the exact original and labels it out of copyright with unrestricted public use.
